methods.name: public abstract int getErrorCode()
methods.comment:
* Gets the error code of the error. The code corresponds to one * of the {@code ERROR_*} constants in {@link WebViewClient}. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#WEB_RESOURCE_ERROR_GET_CODE}. * * @return The error code of the error

methods.name: public abstract CharSequence getDescription()
methods.comment:
* Gets the string describing the error. Descriptions are localized, * and thus can be used for communicating the problem to the user. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#WEB_RESOURCE_ERROR_GET_DESCRIPTION}. * * @return The description of the error
